# `aitbc blockchain height`

Get the current blockchain height from a node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain height [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--db` | flag | `false` | no | Read the local chain.db directly (read-only); needs no running rpc unit |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain height
aitbc blockchain height --output json
```
